description: Reads a list literal written as a string and returns its float32 values as a BLOB
comment: Use it as the query vector of a search. It bypasses the cost of binding a list literal element by element.
example: SELECT id FROM t ORDER BY array_distance(embedding, duckir_vss_encode_query('[0.25, 0.79, -0.50]')) LIMIT 10;

description: Euclidean distance between a FLOAT[d] array and a query vector given as a BLOB of float32 values
comment: DuckIR adds this BLOB overload, also as the <-> operator. The BLOB must hold exactly d float32 values.
example: SELECT id FROM t ORDER BY array_distance(embedding, duckir_vss_encode_query('[0.25, 0.79, -0.50]')) LIMIT 10;

description: Cosine distance between a FLOAT[d] array and a query vector given as a BLOB of float32 values
comment: DuckIR adds this BLOB overload, also as the <=> operator. The BLOB must hold exactly d float32 values.
example: SELECT id FROM t ORDER BY array_cosine_distance(embedding, duckir_vss_encode_query('[0.25, 0.79, -0.50]')) LIMIT 10;

description: Euclidean distance between a FLOAT[d] array and a query vector given as a BLOB of float32 values
comment: Operator form of the array_distance BLOB overload that DuckIR adds. The BLOB must hold exactly d float32 values.
example: SELECT id FROM t ORDER BY embedding <-> duckir_vss_encode_query('[0.25, 0.79, -0.50]') LIMIT 10;

description: Cosine distance between a FLOAT[d] array and a query vector given as a BLOB of float32 values
comment: Operator form of the array_cosine_distance BLOB overload that DuckIR adds. The BLOB must hold exactly d float32 values.
example: SELECT id FROM t ORDER BY embedding <=> duckir_vss_encode_query('[0.25, 0.79, -0.50]') LIMIT 10;

description: Returns metadata about all DuckIR vector indexes
comment: One row per index, with its table, index options, and in-memory size.

description: Synchronize the index to force it to process its maintenance backlog
comment: Otherwise, the first search after a bulk load pays this indexing cost. Returns the index name and whether it had rows to index.
